notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Glamermite with haste.
When the token Glamermite enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Glamermite trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Glamermite.
Repeat.
